# REPO rules

## REPO-001 Only squash merges are allowed

**Level:** proposed · **Applies to:** all projects · **Since:** 0.1.0

One commit per pull request keeps history linear and the changelog readable.

**Verified by:** `repo-setting`

**How to fix:** Settings > General > Pull Requests: allow squash merging only.

## REPO-002 Merged branches are deleted automatically

**Level:** proposed · **Applies to:** all projects · **Since:** 0.1.0

Stale branches hide what is in flight.

**Verified by:** `repo-setting`

## REPO-003 The default branch is protected from force pushes and deletion

**Level:** proposed · **Applies to:** all projects · **Since:** 0.1.0

History on main must not be rewritable.

**Verified by:** `repo-setting`

**How to fix:** Protect the default branch; see docs/repo-setup.md.

## REPO-004 Changes reach main through pull requests with required checks

**Level:** proposed · **Applies to:** all projects · **Since:** 0.1.0

The CI gates only matter if merging without them is impossible.

**Verified by:** `repo-setting`

## REPO-005 Branches must be up to date before merging

**Level:** proposed · **Applies to:** all projects · **Since:** 0.1.0

A green check on a stale branch says nothing about the merged result.

**Verified by:** `repo-setting`

## REPO-006 Secret scanning with push protection is on

**Level:** proposed · **Applies to:** all projects · **Since:** 0.1.0

A secret that never gets pushed never has to be rotated.

**Verified by:** `repo-setting`

## REPO-007 Dependabot alerts are enabled

**Level:** proposed · **Applies to:** all projects · **Since:** 0.1.0

Known-vulnerable dependencies should reach you before an audit does.

**Verified by:** `repo-setting`

## REPO-008 The default workflow token is read-only

**Level:** proposed · **Applies to:** all projects · **Since:** 0.1.0

Workflows should get write rights only where a job asks for them.

**Verified by:** `repo-setting`

## REPO-009 Administrators follow the branch rules

**Level:** proposed · **Applies to:** all projects · **Since:** 0.1.0

Rules with an admin bypass are suggestions. Solo maintainers may waive this one.

**Verified by:** `repo-setting`
